description: This file defines the TaskFactory class responsible for creating instances of scheduled tasks within the OpenMRS platform. It handles class loading, task instantiation, and initialization, using a singleton pattern and incorporating logging.

classes.name: TaskFactory
classes.description: Singleton class responsible for creating and initializing scheduled task instances, wrapping them with threading capabilities.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of TaskFactory.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new Task instance from a given TaskDefinition, handling class loading and exception management.
